messages:
Aria Gomez: quick synthesis from today's onboarding + renewal touchpoints. three consistent asks: (1) finance-friendly export that maps spend to product features, (2) server-side summarization for very long system prompts to control token burn, (3) nightly batch latency spikes for sequences >1500. dropping raw snippets and proposed next steps.
Liam O'Connor: can you list which accounts & any renewal timelines?
Aria Gomez: mapping: - MedSpring (trial): needs export for CFO before trial end (renewal risk). - Atlas Freight (prod): long manifests causing token blowups in chat flows. - BlueMetrics (onboarding): nightly ETL job delayed by p95 latency spikes.
Nina Park: sounds like 1 product ticket, 1 docs/workflow guidance, 1 infra investigation. agree to triage separately.
Victor Huang: priority suggestion: MedSpring export (P0), BlueMetrics perf (P1), Atlas summarization doc + interim caps (P2).
Liam O'Connor: MedSpring export MVP idea: daily CSV per-customer with columns: date,route_id,feature_label,requests,total_tokens,estimated_cost_usd. feasible?
Victor Huang: product-billing can likely ship CSV MVP with 90d retention; need API param for feature_label.
Nina Park: for Atlas, propose server-side summarizer hook + client-side token cap example (4096). I'll draft a how-to.
Aria Gomez: for BlueMetrics, request eng-runtime to run a short profile: p50/p95 for seq bins 512/1024/1536/2048 and GPU utilization. escalate if p95 delta > 1.8x.
CS Bot: triage card created -> CS-4999 by Aria Gomez; owners: @product-billing, @eng-runtime, @docs. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4999
Liam O'Connor: added sample curl for CSV export to the card.
Victor Huang: I'll schedule the runtime profile and post numbers here tomorrow AM.
Aria Gomez: I'll own customer comms and renewal outreach for MedSpring once product confirms ETA. please drop similar signals into this thread so we can aggregate. :pushpin:
thread_summary: CS synthesized onboarding & renewal calls into three asks: finance export (MedSpring renewal risk), server-side summarization for long prompts (Atlas), and runtime profiling for nightly batch latency (BlueMetrics). Card CS-4999 opened with owners and next steps.
